mapper.sql: VAL_ID, PROD_ID, ASSET_ID, VALUE_DATE, MDATE, POS_AMT, TDY_COST_AMT, TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, TDY_INTINCEXP, DELAY_PAY_AMT, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER, STATUS, DATA_SOURCE,MD5PrimaryKey
mapper.select: select distinct CDATE cdate from PTL_SEC_VALUTION where ifnull(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} order by cdate

select * from (select psv1.PROD_ID as PROD_ID, psv1.FINPROD_ID as ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy, psv1.VALUE_DATE as VALUE_DATE, ifnull(fp1.MDATE, fp2.MDATE) as MDATE, sum(psv1.POS_AMT) as POS_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_COST_AMT) as TDY_COST_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL) as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, sum(psv1.TDY_INTINCEXP) as TDY_INTINCEXP, sum(psv1.DELAY_PAY_AMT) as DELAY_PAY_AMT, -- psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, max(psv1.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME, psv1.P_ASSET_ID as P_ASSET_ID from (select psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as PROD_ID, ifnull(ifnull(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID),fp2.FINPROD_ID) as P_ASSET_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_ID, psv.ccy, psv.CDATE as VALUE_DATE, (case fp.finprod_type2 when 'F01' then 100 * psv.SHARE_AMT else psv.SHARE_AMT end) as POS_AMT, psv.DSC_COST_AMT as TDY_COST_AMT, psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP as TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, ifnull(psv.UPDATE_TIME, psv.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fpf on fpf.FINPROD_ID = fp.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 where DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fpf.FINPROD_ID is not null and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID)) psv1 left join FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 group by psv1.PROD_ID, fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, psv1.VALUE_DATE, fp1.MDATE, fp2.MDATE, psv1.FINPROD_ID, psv1.P_ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA_CHILD where DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.select: select * from (select psv1.PROD_ID as PROD_ID, psv1.FINPROD_ID as ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy, psv1.VALUE_DATE as VALUE_DATE, ifnull(fp1.MDATE, fp2.MDATE) as MDATE, sum(psv1.POS_AMT) as POS_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_COST_AMT) as TDY_COST_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL) as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, sum(psv1.TDY_INTINCEXP) as TDY_INTINCEXP, sum(psv1.DELAY_PAY_AMT) as DELAY_PAY_AMT, -- psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, max(psv1.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME, psv1.P_ASSET_ID as P_ASSET_ID from (select psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as PROD_ID, ifnull(ifnull(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID),fp2.FINPROD_ID) as P_ASSET_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_ID, psv.ccy, psv.CDATE as VALUE_DATE, (case fp.finprod_type2 when 'F01' then 100 * psv.SHARE_AMT else psv.SHARE_AMT end) as POS_AMT, psv.DSC_COST_AMT as TDY_COST_AMT, psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP as TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, ifnull(psv.UPDATE_TIME, psv.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fpf on fpf.FINPROD_ID = fp.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 where DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fpf.FINPROD_ID is not null and psv.sec_acct_id = '999999' and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID)) psv1 left join FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 group by psv1.PROD_ID, fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, psv1.VALUE_DATE, fp1.MDATE, fp2.MDATE, psv1.FINPROD_ID, psv1.P_ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null
